exclusions.source_text: Calculated creatinine clearance ≥ 45 mL/min via the Cockcroft-Gault formula for participants with creatinine levels above institutional ULN
Total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 x institutional upper limit of normal (ULN) (or ≤ 2 x ULN in patients with documented Gilbert's syndrome)
AST(SGOT)/ALT(SGPT) ≤ 2.5 x institutional ULN (or \< 5 x ULN in patients with liver metastases)
Baseline LVEF ≥ 50% prior to registration, as measured by echocardiogram
Participants with a history of central nervous system (CNS) metastases are eligible if: Stable or untreated, asymptomatic brain metastases not needing immediate local therapy.
Patients with known brain metastases that are symptomatic or that require therapy for symptom control are not eligible.
Patients who are pregnant or breastfeeding, or who expect to become pregnant within the projected duration of the study.
History of myocardial infarction, acute coronary syndrome or coronary angioplasty/stenting/bypass grafting within the last six months
congestive heart failure (CHF) New York Heart Association (NYHA) Class II-IV or history of CHF NYHA Class III or IV.
Moderate or severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh B or C).

Patients with a history of different malignancy are ineligible, except for those who have been disease-free for at least three years and are deemed by the investigator to be at low risk for recurrence of the prior malignancy.
